title: Line-up of Sporting Events at Sports Hub
what_it_is: Line-up of Sporting Events at Sports Hub

sections.label: PPP arrangement key intent
sections.summary: The PPP arrangement aimed to manage construction risks and let Government use private sector expertise and marketing networks for Sports Hub activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The key intent of the PPP arrangement, besides managing the risks associated with the construction, was to allow the Government to leverage on the expertise and international marketing networks of the private sector to create a vibrant mix of sports, lifestyle and community activities at the Sports Hub.

sections.label: Sports Hub events line-up
sections.summary: The Sports Hub will host sporting events, National School Games, entertainment, lifestyle events, programmed activities, and the National Day Parade.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: For this year, we understand that the Sports Hub will play host to sporting events like the World Rugby Sevens Series, Super Rugby, Singapore Badminton Open, Women's Tennis Association Finals and OCBC Cycle, amongst others.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Sports Hub will also be hosting the National School Games.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In addition to major sporting events, the Sports Hub is lining up entertainment and lifestyle events that cater to everyone, like "Disney on Ice" for the family.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Furthermore, there will be more programmed sporting activities, such as free Learn-to-Play programmes, regular fitness classes and events like the 100 Plus Promenade Run and the Sports Hub Stepper Challenge.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Sports Hub will also be welcoming many Singaporeans for the National Day Parade which will be held at the new National Stadium for the first time.

sections.label: SHPL major events obligation
sections.summary: SHPL may need to work harder to get more major events, with the 2016 line-up still being firmed up.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, does it mean that SHPL has to work harder to get more major events?

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We are still in the process of firming up the line-up for 2016.

sections.label: Contract obligation enforcement
sections.summary: There is a contractual obligation to the Government, which will ensure it is discharged properly and public expectations are met.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As far as we are concerned, there is an obligation to us under the contract.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We will see to it that their obligation to the contract is discharged properly and the expectation of the Government and the public is being met.
